name: Graeter's Ice Cream
dsc: Graeter's Ice Cream is a Cincinnati institution known for its rich, creamy texture and generous chunks of chocolate and other mix-ins. Their French pot process creates a dense, velvety ice cream that is unlike any other. This 6-pint pack allows you to choose your favorite flavors from their extensive selection, including classic Black Raspberry Chocolate Chip, Mint Chocolate Chip, and seasonal specialties. Each pint is crafted with premium ingredients and a family recipe that has been perfected over generations. Perfect for sharing with family and friends or enjoying a scoop (or two) after a long day.

name: Nancy Silverton's Nancy's Fancy
dsc: Nancy Silverton's Nancy's Fancy Gelato Gift Box features handcrafted Italian-style gelato made with the finest ingredients. This gift box includes six pints of their most popular gelato flavors, each one creamy, rich, and intensely flavorful. Nancy Silverton, a James Beard Award-winning chef, uses a slow-churning process that results in a dense, silky texture that is truly exceptional. This gift box is perfect for special occasions, holidays, or as a thoughtful gift for any food lover.

name: Anderson's Frozen Custard
dsc: Anderson's Frozen Custard is a Buffalo favorite that combines the richness of frozen custard with the variety of handmade ice cream. This 6-pack includes six pints of their frozen custard or handmade ice cream, allowing you to choose your favorite flavors. The custard is incredibly creamy and smooth, while the ice cream is rich and flavorful. Both are made with premium ingredients and a commitment to quality that has made Anderson's a beloved institution. Perfect for any occasion, this pack is a great way to enjoy a taste of Buffalo.

The Baked Bear is known for its creative flavors and delicious combinations, and this pack is a great way to sample a variety. Perfect for parties, gatherings, or just stocking your freezer.

Perfect for parties, date nights, or a special indulgence, this pack offers a fun and delicious way to enjoy ice cream with a kick.
